en: Romans 14

p.src: 1  Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

ja: れなさい。ただし、意見をめぐって言い争うためではありません。
en: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
u.src: 1  Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

p.src: 2  One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

en: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
u.src: 2  One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

p.src: 3  Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

ja: れてくださったからです。
en: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
u.src: 3  Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

p.src: 4  Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

ja: の前でのことです。しかし、その
つのです。神には、その人を
たせる力があるからです。
en: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
u.src: 4  Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

p.src: 5  One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

en: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
u.src: 5  One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

p.src: 6  He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

ja: のために大切にします。その日を大切にしない
のためにそうしません。
して、主のために食べます。
en: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
u.src: 6  He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

p.src: 7  For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

en: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
u.src: 7  For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

p.src: 8  For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

en: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
u.src: 8  For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

p.src: 9  For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

en: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
u.src: 9  For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

p.src: 10  But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

ja: それなのに、なぜあなたは
くのですか。また、なぜあなたは
蔑するのですか。私たちは
en: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
u.src: 10  But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

p.src: 11  For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

ja: かれています。 「『私は生きている』と
にかがみ、 すべての
en: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
u.src: 11  For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

p.src: 12  So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

en: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
u.src: 12  So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

p.src: 13  Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

ja: わないようにしましょう。むしろ、
en: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
u.src: 13  Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

p.src: 14  I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

ja: れているものは何もありません。ただし、何かを
en: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
u.src: 14  I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

p.src: 15  Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

ja: しませるなら、あなたはもはや
んではいません。キリストがその
んでくださったのですから、あなたの
en: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
u.src: 15  Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

p.src: 16  Then don’t let your good be slandered,

ja: ですから、あなたがたが良いとすることが、
われないようにしなさい。
en: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
u.src: 16  Then don’t let your good be slandered,

p.src: 17  for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

en: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
u.src: 17  for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

p.src: 18  For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

ja: このようにキリストに
en: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
u.src: 18  For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

p.src: 19  So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

en: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
u.src: 19  So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

p.src: 20  Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

ja: してはなりません。確かに、すべてのものは
をつまずかせるなら、それは
en: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
u.src: 20  Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

p.src: 21  It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

ja: をつまずかせ、妨げとなり、
もしないのが良いのです。
en: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
u.src: 21  It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

p.src: 22  Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

ja: めたことについて、良心に
en: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
u.src: 22  Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

p.src: 23  But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

ja: によるものではないからです。
によらないことはすべて
en: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
u.src: 23  But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

ja: 私の福音、すなわちイエス・キリストについての宣教と、長い時代にわたって隠されていた秘められた真理の啓示とに従って、あなたがたを堅く立たせることのできる方に。
en: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

ja: この真理は今や明らかにされ、永遠の神の命令に従って、預言者たちの書を通してすべての国々に知らされ、信仰の従順へと導いています。
en: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

ja: その唯一の知恵ある神に、イエス・キリストを通して、永遠に栄光がありますように。アーメン。
en: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

ja: 14:26 TRは24-26節を、ローマ人への手紙16:24の後に25-27節として置いている。
en: 14:26 TR places verses 24-26 after Romans 16:24 as verses 25-27.
